metric_definitions.observation_window: Zero to final completion/stall, or the configured timeout; per-policy window is recorded.
metric_definitions.utilization: 100 * integral(used/capacity dt) / observation seconds, per resource; includes idle gaps.
metric_definitions.resource_imbalance_percent: Time average of max minus min cluster utilization across resource types; not demand-aware fragmentation.
metric_definitions.mean_wait_seconds: Mean accumulated QUEUED/WAITING time for completed jobs only; incomplete counts are reported separately.
metric_definitions.p95_wait_seconds: Nearest-rank 95th percentile of accumulated waiting among completed jobs; null when none finish.
metric_definitions.mean_slowdown: Mean (completion - arrival) / requested runtime among completed jobs.
metric_definitions.starvation_rate_percent: Percent of feasible arrived jobs whose observed cumulative waiting exceeds the configured threshold, including unfinished jobs.
metric_definitions.makespan_seconds: Final completion time from zero, including arrival gaps; null for incomplete/stalled workloads.
metric_definitions.preemption_overhead: Not modeled; progress is preserved and interruption/recovery cost is assumed zero.
metric_definitions.paired_delta: Policy metric minus baseline metric on the exact same trace; missing metrics are not replaced with zero.
metric_definitions.bootstrap_interval: Exploratory 95% percentile interval for paired mean differences; 2000 seeded resamples of distinct workloads. Null with fewer than two pairs.

warnings: Synthetic workloads on three identical simulated GPUs; zero checkpoint/recovery overhead.
Paired bootstrap intervals are exploratory and do not establish universal superiority.
Only one distinct workload: confidence intervals are unavailable.
